gaps.sentence: The charity provides ___ shelter for homeless families in winter.
gaps.explanation: 'Shelter' is uncountable and general here, so no article is used.

gaps.sentence: They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: ___ honesty is the best policy, as the saying goes.
gaps.explanation: Abstract nouns used in a general sense take no article: honesty, happiness, love.

gaps.sentence: He found ___ coin buried in the sand.
gaps.explanation: 'A coin' first mention; 'in the sand' — sand as a mass takes 'the' here (the sand on that beach).

gaps.sentence: ___ noise pollution in cities is getting worse.
gaps.explanation: 'Noise pollution' as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: We stayed at ___ hotel right next to the station.
gaps.explanation: 'The station' — in a town there is usually one known station; context makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.
